lead: Dreamy film still, drab grey corporate city, soft ethereal pink light.
notes: Mood-only mini images for kickblade.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen kickblade-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish kickblade-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: city
images.prompt: Glass office towers over worn concrete, a cargo elevator climbing the side of one.

images.name: heroine
images.prompt: A young woman with soft pink hair in a pink and white frilly outfit, seen from behind on a grey street.

images.name: executive
